label: The change was merged at 08:12 and deployed at 08:31. Errors passed 5% at 08:40, and saving failed for 47 minutes, until 09:27. The page came at 08:44; the cause was found at 09:14, after 8 minutes spent on read replicas, and the rollback started at 09:19.

rows.name: Change merged
rows.note: Platform engineer. A change to the shared configuration template moves the pool size into a new section, where a default of 20 applies.

rows.name: Deployed to all regions
rows.note: The deploy pipeline sends the new configuration to all three regions at once.

rows.name: Saving failed
rows.note: People could not save changes. Up to 61% of requests failed.

rows.name: Alert pages on-call
rows.note: Monitoring. The alert "sync errors above 5% for 3 minutes" pages the on-call engineer.

rows.name: Incident declared, sev 2
rows.note: The status page says saving is failing.

rows.name: Read replicas added
rows.note: On the guess that the database is overloaded. Errors do not change.

rows.name: Cause found in the logs
rows.note: Database engineer. "Connection pool exhausted, limit 20" in the API logs, and the change in the deploy history.

rows.name: Incident resolved
rows.note: The app sends its kept changes again.

rows.name: Status page closed
rows.note: Support lead, after an hour with no errors.
